scenes.text: ₹50,000 ke ads. Landing page pe *ye 4 galtiyan*.
scenes.say: Pachaas hazaar ke ads chal rahe the. Landing page pe chaar galtiyan.

scenes.title: Phone pe *pehli screen*

bad.label: Abhi
bad.text: Load time. Bada slider, project ka naam, bas

scenes.say: Phone pe page aath second mein khula. Aur pehli screen pe sirf slider. Price, location, kuch nahi.

scenes.title: Kya galat tha:
items: *"Price on request"*: buyer wapas chala gaya
scenes.say: Price on request, saat fields ka form, WhatsApp button footer mein, aur thank you page nahi, to tracking bhi nahi.

scenes.title: Fix:
scenes.say: Pehli screen pe price range aur location. Teen field ka form. Floating WhatsApp button. Aur thank you page pe conversion tag.

scenes.text: Aapka landing page *kitne leads* gira raha hai?
scenes.say: Comment karo AUDIT, free audit karenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.
